config_used.description: Configuration for filtering and classifying inter-feature similarity pairs. Reads raw data from script 6, applies thresholds, outputs classified pairs.

processing_notes.classification_logic: semantic_sim > threshold → Semantic pair; char_jaccard > threshold OR word_jaccard > threshold → Lexical pair
processing_notes.both_patterns: Pairs meeting both conditions are added to both semantic_pairs and lexical_pairs
dependencies: 6_interfeature_similarity.py must be run first to generate raw parquet

field_descriptions.semantic_pairs: Feature pairs with semantic similarity above threshold
field_descriptions.lexical_pairs: Feature pairs with lexical similarity above threshold (char OR word Jaccard)
field_descriptions.pattern_type: Classification: 'Semantic' or 'Lexical' (pairs can appear in both lists)

notes.threshold_experimentation: Run with different thresholds using CLI args: --semantic-threshold 0.5 --char-jaccard-threshold 0.4
notes.quick_rerun: This script is fast since it only filters pre-computed data from script 6
